up: Retrieve the ChEMBL compound identifiers, exact activity values, and chemical structures for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649965. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, the exact standard value, the standard units, and the canonical SMILES for each activity record. Filter activities to include only those with exact values (standard_relation = '=' and standard_value is not null). Do not apply any additional filters on confidence scores, document types, or target types. Return all matching rows without limiting the result set.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649965' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
